title: weather-snapshot.json
description: Per-batch FROZEN weather library: the exact Open-Meteo-compatible responses the same-origin cache-api served during the batch, one per (city,date) in manifest.cities, plus the canary expected-value table the fidelity golden checks against (scheme §1.2 'snapshot hash (canary 数值,如 max 27.4°/min 13.9°/code 61)'). This artifact's raw bytes are the input to manifest.snapshot_sha256 (DATA-LAYOUT §2). Because it is a directly-hashed byte stream like manifest.json, the SAME byte-exact discipline applies — RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization, NFC-first on every string, and the canonical decimal-string grammar for every non-integer numeric value (see CONTRACT-NOTES §1-§3). WARNING: JSON Schema validates SHAPE ONLY; the runner MUST enforce JCS/NFC/decimal-string and re-derivable snapshot_sha256. schema_version 1.0.0; file SHA256 + version frozen into lock (scheme §11).
$comment: schema_version: 1.0.0. FLAGGED scheme-silent choices: (1) Open-Meteo wire format uses JSON NUMBERS for temperatures/coords, but this FROZEN artifact encodes every non-integer as a canonical decimal STRING for hash reproducibility (same rationale as manifest coordinates, DECISIONS-M0 §2/§3); the cache-api re-materializes JSON-number wire shape when serving to the browser. (2) fetched_at is a FROZEN deterministic value (the init-script Date freeze target, scheme §2.2) and DOES enter snapshot_sha256. (3) The exact set of response fields is fixed by the pinned contract query (daily=temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,weather_code; hourly=temperature_2m; timezone=UTC; temperature_unit=celsius), so additionalProperties:false is safe.

batch_id.description: Owning batch id (date + event slug, DESIGN §2.2).

extractor_version.description: The extractor_version this canary expected-value table was written against (scheme §1.2 '期望值表随 extractor 版本落盘'; §4/§11 golden written independently and version-pinned). MUST equal the locked extractor_version and the value carried by meta.json.fidelity / fidelity-trace.json for the same batch, so a re-versioned extractor drifting away from a stale canary is detectable from the bytes. FROZEN and enters snapshot_sha256.

source.description: Upstream weather source the response shape mimics. cache-api is Open-Meteo-compatible (DESIGN §4.3).

fetched_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp the snapshot was captured. This is the FROZEN value the shoot init-script pins Date/snapshot 'fetched_at' to (scheme §2.2). FROZEN and deterministic → it DOES enter snapshot_sha256 (unlike the presentational timestamps in index.json).

locations.description: One served response per (city,date) fixture. MUST cover exactly manifest.cities; (city,date) unique AFTER NFC (runner-enforced, same discipline as manifest.cities). Persisted order = same JCS-byte order as manifest.cities (runner-enforced).

city.description: City name; equals the matching manifest.cities[].city after NFC.

date.description: UTC calendar date; equals the matching manifest.cities[].date. Runner must reject impossible calendar dates (Draft 2020-12 format is annotation-only).

lat.description: Requested latitude as a canonical decimal string; equals the matching manifest.cities[].lat.

lon.description: Requested longitude as a canonical decimal string; equals the matching manifest.cities[].lon.

endpoint.description: Which whitelisted cache-api endpoint served this (city,date): /api/om/forecast or /api/om/archive (scheme §6 whitelist). Chosen by date relative to fetched_at.

response.description: The Open-Meteo-compatible response body served for this (city,date), verbatim shape, non-integer numerics as canonical decimal strings (see $comment).

canary.description: Canary expected-value table for this (city,date), versioned with extractor_version. The independently-written golden the fidelity extractor is checked against (scheme §1.2, §4 'golden fixtures 期望值独立预先写定'). Derived from response but persisted separately so a drifting response is detectable.

daily.description: Expected daily values (scheme §1.2 canary e.g. max 27.4 / min 13.9 / code 61).

temperature_2m_max.description: Expected daily max °C, canonical decimal string.

temperature_2m_min.description: Expected daily min °C, canonical decimal string.

hourly_temperature_2m.description: Expected hourly temperature_2m °C for UTC hours 0..23 in order (24 values). Canonical decimal strings.

decimalString.description: Canonical decimal string grammar (CONTRACT-NOTES §3): no exponent / no leading + / no leading zero except 0.x / no trailing decimal zero / no -0.

omResponse.description: Open-Meteo-compatible response object. Field set is fixed by the pinned contract query. All non-integer numerics are canonical decimal strings in this FROZEN artifact (see top-level $comment).

latitude.description: Grid-snapped latitude Open-Meteo echoes (may differ from requested lat within ±0.01, scheme §3 tolerance).

generationtime_ms.description: Open-Meteo generation time (ms) as served; frozen value, canonical decimal string.

utc_offset_seconds.description: UTC offset in seconds; 0 for timezone=UTC/GMT (contract query pins timezone=UTC).

timezone.description: Timezone as served (e.g. 'GMT'); contract query pins UTC.

elevation.description: Elevation (m) as served, canonical decimal string.

daily_units.description: Unit strings for the daily block (e.g. temperature '°C', weather_code 'wmo code').

daily.description: Daily block. The harness passes ?date= for a single UTC day (start_date=end_date), so arrays are length 1; all four arrays share the same length and index alignment (runner-enforced).

temperature_2m_max.description: Daily max °C per day, canonical decimal strings.

hourly_units.description: Unit strings for the hourly block.

hourly.description: Hourly block for one UTC day = 24 points (hours 0..23). Both arrays length 24, index-aligned (runner-enforced).

time.description: 24 UTC hour timestamps (ISO 8601 local-naive UTC, e.g. '2026-08-01T00:00').

temperature_2m.description: 24 hourly temperature_2m °C, canonical decimal strings, hours 0..23 in order.
